purpose: Phase 1 production-art worker candidate derived from the visually coherent supplied worker rather than the rejected procedural #58 mesh

rights.statement: Project owner confirms the supplied asset is licensed for this project. Exact provider/licence identifier metadata may be archived separately and is not a technical admission blocker.

r2_transform.method: deterministically split every source triangle into two triangles along its longest edge; preserve source silhouette, UV interpolation, material and embedded texture; generate smooth normals from the source topology
r2_transform.visual_intent: preserve the supplied worker appearance that QA previously found coherent, while satisfying the documented 25k-50k Phase 1 production geometry target
